claims.text: High-entropy alloys with refined grain structures and engineered precipitation can exhibit enhanced catalytic activity toward HER and HOR.
High-entropy alloys with refined grain structures and engineered precipitation can exhibit enhanced durability during HER and HOR.
Spark plasma sintering can refine the grain structure and engineer precipitation in HEAs.
Laser cladding can refine the grain structure and engineer precipitation in HEAs.
High-pressure, high-temperature treatment can refine the grain structure and engineer precipitation in HEAs.
Refined grain structure and controlled precipitation enhance catalytic surface area.
Refined grain structure and controlled precipitation reduce defect density.
Refined grain structure and controlled precipitation optimize the electronic structure of HEAs.
Enhanced surface area improves HER and HOR catalytic activity.
Reduced defect density improves catalytic activity and durability.
Optimized electronic structure improves HER and HOR catalytic activity and durability.
Traditional electrode materials have limited catalytic activity and durability.
The exact relationship among grain refinement, precipitation engineering, and catalytic activity remains uncertain.
